description: Shared policy from the four presets below. Runtime dependencies, extras and the exact build pins (mypy, the uv version inputs) stay manual: local automerge: false rules below protect those exact pins. Security PRs come from Dependabot only (see .github/dependabot.yml), so extras/security-alerts is deliberately not extended.

packageRules.description: [automerge] Keep the exact mypy pin manual. It sits in [dependency-groups] 'test', which the Python preset automerges; a mypy release could change the type check without the same reviewers seeing it

[automerge] Keep the exact uv version inputs manual. The Python preset groups and automerges the 'version' of astral-sh/setup-uv in the Saturday uv slot. Renovate reports that version input as astral-sh/uv with depType uses-with, in the same file as the action's uses-with ref, so this rule also keeps the action reference manual in these files; the action digest in the automerged GitHub Actions group still updates it. The same version pin in publish-release.yaml only runs on a release, which PR CI never exercises
